results.title: The Ohio Gamma
results.text:
Red Door HONOR THE PAST ~ CELEBRATE THE PRESENT ~ CREATE THE FUTURE

A key element of our alumni function is event planning. Our alumni events lead to more involved alumni. Involved alumni lead to a better relationship with our undergrads and a continually outstanding undergrad chapter. We have had an active 2015 calendar of Alumni Events - some old and some new. In mid-June we had another 1960’s Sig Ep Reunion (our third). This event featured a Friday night reception at the Embassy Suites, golf at New Albany Golf Links, an Ohio Union and Campus walking tour and a spirited dinner at the 94th Aero Squadron restaurant. This event demonstrates how our Sig Ep friendships have stood the test of time for well over 50 years. Of special significance, we honored Lin Boling (wife of Brian Boling) and presented her with the first Lifetime Sig Ep Sweetheart award for her outstanding contribution as our Reunion coordinator for the past 50 years. Jim Doyle created a DVD of a composite of 8mm films that were taken in the 60’s and you can view that video at https://vimeo. com/135719549. If your group has not had a reunion, you should plan to do so. More on this later. In August we had our annual Golf Outing at Glenross Golf Course. The weather was fantastic, the scores were ” interesting” and many purchased $10 mulligan’s to improve their chances of winning. Everyone donated their winnings, and along with the Phillips-Barnett side bet, we were able to donate over $800 to the Chapter Scholars
